newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: POSCO to seek 1,000 T of ferro-chrome.
newsitem.headline: POSCO to seek 1,000 T of ferro-chrome.

text.p: Pohang Iron and Steel Co Ltd (POSCO) will tender for 1,000 tonnes of ferro-chrome at 2.00 p.m. local (0500 GMT) on January 17, a POSCO official said on Thursday.

The chemical specification of the ferro-chrome must include chrome at a minimum of 53 percent, carbon at maximum of 3.0 percent, silicon at a maximum of 0.5 percent, and sulphur and phosphorus at a maximum of 0.025 percent, the official said.
The shipment date was set for February to the port city of Pohang or Pusan. POSCO is the largest steel maker in South Korea.
The official said all the bids must be submitted by 2.00 p.m. local (0500 GMT) on January 16.
